Please press the <Tab> button to see all available commands.
You can also use the <Tab> button to prompt or auto-complete all commands or its subcommands.
You can try to call commands with <-h> or <--help> parameter for more information.

Available commands:
  argb      :Adaptive feedback control
  bistable  :Bistable behavior control
  board     :Control the device
  clear     :Clear screen.
  curve     :Acceleration curves
  esb       :ESB endpoint commands
  help      :Prints the help message.
  keymap    :Keymap management
  p2sm      :Sensor mixer configuration
  plane     :Rotate plane processor
  rem       :Ignore lines beginning with 'rem '
  retval    :Print return value of most recent command
  rrl       :Report rate limiter
  rtcfg     :Runtime configuration
  sensor    :Sensor diagnostics
  shell     :Useful, not Unix-like shell commands.
